answer: Sustained attention probation grants write rights only after an identity keeps continuous, task-specific focus across rotating windows. A terrace queue enforces first-come ordering, and any lapse resets the identity’s timer. Focus evidence is hashed into a crystal audit record tied to that session, so replay or cloning fails. The cost is one operator’s concurrent attention per identity plus compute, forcing an attacker’s sybil orchard to staff each session separately.
